# Investing Launch Standup 2026-10-10

**Format:** Async written standup (weekend before go/no-go week). Updates posted by each owner; Renee summarized.
**Contributors:** Renee Alvarez, Devon Park, Nadia Okafor, Lin Zhao, Kavi Raman, Sarah Kim
**GA target:** Oct 20 (at risk). **Go/no-go #2:** Friday Oct 16 (Go-No-Go 2 - Agenda).

## Blockers

**B1 Reconciliation fix (Devon).** Rollout plan posted in Confluence: Reconciliation Fix - Rollout Plan. Marcus Bell approved the PR Friday evening with two small changes, both done. Plan: merge Tuesday Oct 13 before the evening reconciliation window, first clean daily run Oct 14, second Oct 15. A rollback flag restores the old adjustment logic without touching positions. Still due Oct 14.

**B2 Disclosures.** Closed Oct 7.

**B3 Android parity (Nadia).** Performance detail screen is in review. Chart component done; remaining work is accessibility labels and the dollar-first display under $25 that Lin specced. On track for Oct 15.

## Other updates

- **Corrected-positions notice (Lin).** Copy draft shared with Hana Ito. Shows old and new share quantities and says no money moved. Hana's review due Monday.
- **Ramp (Kavi).** Plan written: 25% / 50% / 100% over a week from GA, each step gated on a clean reconciliation run and ticket rate under 25 per 1k funded users.
- **Ops (Sarah).** Funding transfers normal. Sent Theresa Lowe the written notice for the Sidekiq ACH deletion (planned Oct 16).
- **Hiring, relevant to us (Nadia).** Aleks Varga approved the above-band comp for Ama (senior iOS). Offer went out today. If she accepts, she starts in November and takes over investing iOS reviews.
- **Diligence (Renee, from Maya).** Sam Whitfield closed the Q3 access review (Q3 Access Review - Completed). One less open SOC 2 gap going into the Elena Sorensen call on Oct 14.

## Decisions

Decision: Reconciliation fix merges Oct 13 behind a rollback flag; go/no-go #2 needs the Oct 14 and Oct 15 runs clean (Devon, Renee).

Risk: Nothing in the plan has slack. Any problem with the Oct 13 merge pushes GA past Oct 20.

Risk: Ticket rate (21 per 1k last week) is close to the ramp gate of 25. A corrected-positions notice could spike it.

Open question: Do we ramp to 25% on Oct 20 or after the Oct 21 board meeting? Still open for go/no-go #2.

## Action items

- [ ] Devon: land position reconciliation fix by 2026-10-14
- [ ] Nadia: ship Android parity for the two investing screens by 2026-10-15
- [ ] Hana: review corrected-positions notice copy by 2026-10-12
- [ ] Renee: macro for corrected positions by 2026-10-15
- [ ] Renee: refresh Investing Launch Checklist and send pre-read by 2026-10-15
- [ ] Renee: run go/no-go #2 by 2026-10-16
- [x] Devon: reconciliation fix rollout plan by 2026-10-10
- [x] Kavi: GA ramp plan by 2026-10-16
- [x] Nadia: get comp approval and extend senior iOS offer to Ama by 2026-10-10
